request.spec:
A steward can flag a person with a reason and an until date (entries and a button on the row;
PERSON_FLAGGED name=<name> reason=<reason> until=<date>; anyone else or a blank reason is refused
with an error on the row). While the sheet's today is on or before the until date the row shows the
reason, and only a steward may open a claim of that person (alone, by the bulk button, or by a
paste); after the date the flag shows nothing and has no effect.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A steward can flag a person with a reason and an until date (entries and a button on the row;
PERSON_FLAGGED name=<name> reason=<reason> until=<date>; anyone else or a blank reason is refused
with an error on the row). While the sheet's today is on or before the until date the row shows the
reason, and only a steward may open a claim of that person (alone, by the bulk button, or by a

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The flag feature works: the main `flags` test passes, and so does `flags scenario 2`. Scenarios 1 and 3 still fail, on things that have nothing to do with flags. Neither scenario ever flags anyone; they only check that `person-flag-shown` is empty.

**What I built**
- **Storage:** a new `person_flag` table (`V82__person_flag.sql`) holding one flag per person: a reason and an until date. Flagging again replaces the old flag.
- **Server:**
  - `PUT /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/flag` is refused for anyone who isn't a steward, for a blank reason and for a bad date, and then stores nothing. Otherwise it writes `PERSON_FLAGGED … name= reason= until=`. A blank until date defaults to the sheet's today.
  - `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/flags` lists the sheet's flags.
  - The code is in a new `flag` package.
- **Opening claims:** the check is in `ApplyClaimStatus`. While the sheet's today is on or before the until date, only a steward can open that person's claims. The single open button, the bulk open button and paste all go through this code, so all three are covered. A refused paste is rolled back and writes nothing. I had to pass the flag store into the two other places that call this code (`AddPastedClaims`, `ApplyBulkSettle`).
- **Screen:** a new Flag column on each person row (`features/flags/flag.slot.tsx`) with `person-flag-shown`, `person-flag-reason`, `person-flag-until` and the `person-flag` button. Whether the reason shows is worked out from the sheet's today, so it disappears once the date has passed. Errors appear in the row's existing `person-error`.

**The two failures I didn't fix**
- **Scenario 1:** the person is edited twice in the same way, clearing their terms, and the test expects both edits to log `PERSON_EDITED … terms=20`. The app logs `terms=` only when an edit actually changes the stored terms, so only the first edit gets it. I took my change out and re-ran: it fails on exactly the same audit line, so this was there before me.
- **Scenario 3:** while the screen shows the sheet as of 2026-04-02, Ben's due-total shows `n/a` where the test expects `0.00`. Without my change this scenario stops earlier, on the missing flag element, so I couldn't watch the original code reach this step. But nobody is flagged in it, and nothing I added touches the due-total, so it can't come from my change.

Fixing either would mean guessing how the reference app handles terms edits or the as-of view, which is outside this request, so I left both alone. I can look into them separately if you want.

One small gap: a refused flag shows its error in the error spot the Hold column owns. If someone hides the Hold column, the error won't appear on screen, although the refusal still works. The existing Watch button has the same gap.
